title: otiophora pauciflora subsp. burttii
intro: Otiophora pauciflora subsp. burttii, commonly known as the Burtt's otiophora, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Otiophora pauciflora subsp. burttii include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of infections. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds have been identified in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties.
